alignment.reason: Single deterministic post-pass over rendered document text in one service; auditable cleanup decisions in cleanup.json are untouched, the user picked this location and the hyphen policy explicitly, and backward compatibility for existing cleanup artifacts was waived.
alignment.source: Chat 2026-07-27: user reported AI translation mirroring mid-sentence line breaks; root cause is AI Cleanup. User chose to unwrap only in AI Cleanup at document render, and to join hyphen-terminated wraps without a space while keeping the hyphen.
alignment.understanding: AI-assisted cleanup retains story slices byte-exact, so single LF characters that PDF extraction inserts at every wrapped line survive into clean_text.txt, chunks_text.json, the translation prompt, and TTS. Deterministic cleanup already unwraps these through _compose_paragraph_text, so the two cleanup modes disagree. Document rendering must join intra-paragraph line breaks into single spaces while keeping blank-line paragraph boundaries and form-feed page markers intact.
